engineering_recipes.title: Quête : machine à états
engineering_recipes.expected_observable_success: accepted quest flag / observed objective progress
engineering_recipes.common_failure_modes: duplicate requests; missing target; reconnect; death
engineering_recipes.do_not_assume: Never assume the quest remote name or acceptance result

engineering_recipes.title: Quête : preuve de progression
engineering_recipes.expected_observable_success: objective count increases after a valid action
engineering_recipes.common_failure_modes: quest UI desync; quest cancel; server rollback
engineering_recipes.do_not_assume: UI text alone may be stale

engineering_recipes.title: Boss : apparition et disparition
engineering_recipes.expected_observable_success: boss instance appears with confirmed identity
engineering_recipes.common_failure_modes: absent boss; duplicate names; streamed-out NPC
engineering_recipes.do_not_assume: Do not assume all NPCs are replicated

engineering_recipes.title: Boss : timer de réapparition
engineering_recipes.expected_observable_success: observed death and later respawn, measured delay
engineering_recipes.common_failure_modes: timer drift; server restart; missing spawn
engineering_recipes.do_not_assume: Do not invent exact respawn delay

engineering_recipes.title: Boss : attendre le butin
engineering_recipes.expected_observable_success: inventory delta / reward UI / stable loot state
engineering_recipes.do_not_assume: Do not declare loot picked without observable state

engineering_recipes.title: Boss : sélection des cibles
engineering_recipes.expected_observable_success: chosen target is alive and eligible
engineering_recipes.do_not_assume: Client does not dictate server NPC behavior

generation_policy: Use validated public data and available sources. Never fabricate game APIs. If a mechanism is unknown, generate a parameterized adapter with clear TODOs or explain what cannot be proven; do not claim the script is fully functional.
diagnostic_notes: Public metadata and code libraries do not reveal private server-side APIs.
A remotes name, damage rule or quest system must NOT be invented.
A library example does not prove it works in this specific game.
A generated script is NOT game-verified until a runtime test produces observable evidence.
Do not assume server ownership or permissions unavailable to a client.
